# GitHub Copilot Instructions: BPMN for Mermaid

The repository root `AGENTS.md` is the canonical guide for this project. Read
it before generating code, comments, or documentation. It defines the current
paths, architecture, scope limits, DSL rules, generated-file policy, and
validation commands.

For source changes, also read the relevant standards file under
`app/standards/`, especially `parser-safety-checklist.md` for parser work and
`bpmn-spec-reference.md` for notation work.

Keep this file short. If it conflicts with `AGENTS.md`, update this pointer
instead of copying a second long set of repository rules here.
